messages.subject: International Energy & Industrial Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Walker,

Your senior executive-search work across energy, industrial, engineering and construction leadership makes this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy and strategic partnerships.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where regulated operations, institutional trust, infrastructure delivery and responsible development must align. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate assignments across the GCC and wider global markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
